feeds.title: AirlineReporter
feeds.description: AirlineReporter is a place to share your passion for airlines. It covers articles on aviation, travel, and airlines. Most of us are working professionals, who want to share our passion with you. This is written by a team of writers across four continents, this is one of the best sites for aviation news and innovation from around the world.

feeds.title: Aviation News
feeds.description: The leading independent voice for aviation news and insight. International Aviation News, Airshow reports, Aircraft facts, world's largest Aviation Museum database. Civilians, Military & Space, we cover it all. We talk about Aviation news covering airlines, aerospace, air transport, defense, safety, and business aviation by global regions.

feeds.title: General Aviation News
feeds.description: A newspaper for the aviation masses. The General Aviation News website serves up aviation news for pilots and aircraft owners primarily at the grassroots level. The goal is to provide up-to-the-minute, factual details about all aspects of general aviation and do it in a manner that is enjoyable to read. In print twice a month, General Aviation News reports aviation news, information and entertainment rarely read elsewhere.

feeds.title: Simple Flying
feeds.description: Simple Flying is the world's largest aviation news website. Their goal is to provide a one-stop hub for all the key stories on commercial aviation, sharing the news in a simple, accessible way. The site covers all regions and all aspects of commercial aviation, including airline news, analysis, and insights.

feeds.title: World Airline News
feeds.description: Airlines are rapidly changing and it is a very dynamic industry. So is the way airline news is now being reported. Today readers demand rapid 'got to have it now' information, especially on their mobile devices. We are your central hub for the latest news and photos powered by AirlinersGallery.com Images. Get airline videos, route maps and aircraft slide shows with over 24 million views on our website.

feeds.title: Leeham News and Analysis
feeds.description: Leeham News and Analysis is an industry-leading commercial aviation news blog. News and Comment principally focus on news, events, and analysis of issues involving Airbus.

feeds.title: Aero-News Network
feeds.description: Aero-News Network your source for daily aviation/aerospace news. aero-news network provides daily, real-time news and information critical to aviation and aerospace personnel the world over. aero-news provides daily newsletter summaries, RSS feeds, and numerous personal and professional syndication and news distribution options to insure that aviators, the world over, are kept up to date on information of critical concern.

feeds.title: Australian Aviation
feeds.description: Australian Aviation is Australia's most active aviation community, keeping those with a love of aviation informed with all the latest news and in-depth features on the industry. It is the trusted and top source of market intelligence. Delivering insights, breaking news, and information for Australia's aviation sector.

feeds.title: World Aviation Media
feeds.description: World Aviation Media is your premier source for the latest happenings in the global aviation sector. Curated by industry experts, our independent publication brings you a comprehensive roundup of the most impactful news, trends, and analyses from around the world. Whether you're an aviation professional, enthusiast, or simply want to stay informed, our publication ensures you're always in the loop.

feeds.title: AFRVIATOR
feeds.description: Stay updated on the latest developments in Africa's airspace sector. AFRVIATOR is your go-to destination for Aviation, travel, and tourism updates with a focus on Africa and the Indian Ocean. They aim to journey with ambitious air travel brands, shaping Africa's travel narrative while championing authentic and bold storytelling.

feeds.title: Airline Weekly
feeds.description: Airline Weekly is a subscriber-supported publication, paid for by readers who want a more interesting, more valuable read about the airline business. Each Monday, Airline Weekly reports who's flying where, new marketing approaches, fleet, finance and key airline and airport data. And most importantly, Airline Weekly readers enjoy insightful analysis and new ideas found nowhere else.

feeds.title: Aviation Source News
feeds.description: AviationSource is the newest aviation website to hit the market, offering an analytical and complex look at the industry. Whilst everyday news will be provided on the website, AviationSource aims to look at the different segues of aviation and how it will affect itself going into the future. AviationSource Is one of the Fastest Growing Aviation News Outlets in the UK.

feeds.title: The Aviationist
feeds.description: Articles on airships, air source, airspace violations, F-104, helicopters, air force and more. This blog shares military aviation news and commentary from around the world by Italian private pilot and former Italian Air Force officer David Cenciotti. Get unmatched, unconventional, independent coverage of military aviation, defense, tech & everything in the middle.

feeds.title: GreenAir News
feeds.description: GreenAir is an online publication dedicated to publishing independent, informative and up-to-the-minute news, features and analysis on current issues surrounding aviation and its impact on climate change and the environment. It has no association with the industry, environmental groups or government bodies and so is able to present opinions from all sides of this debate without fear or favor.

feeds.title: AviationGhana
feeds.description: AviationGhana is the most credible source of aviation news in Ghana and the West Africa sub-region. It is the organizer of the annual Aviation Breakfast Meeting. Get all the modern Ghana news, breaking news headlines, business news and top stories in today's Ghana newspapers. To stay updated, check our website.

feeds.title: Asian Aviation
feeds.description: Asian Aviation is an Asian airlines magazine covering the latest aviation news for the Asia-Pacific region, central and SE Asia.

feeds.title: Aviation for Aviators
feeds.description: Aviation for Aviators is an aviation page that serves, benefits and entertains aviation enthusiasts through social media networking platforms. feeds.title: NYCAviation
feeds.description: At NYCAviation, our mission is to entertain and educate the world on all matters pertaining to aviation. Whether we are providing research or on-air appearances for the mainstream media, sharing great photos and geek talk with fellow enthusiasts, or teaching the ins and outs of the most complicated industry with the flying public through our articles, we show everyone that our human species' ability to fly is not only fascinating and beautiful, but incredibly safe and worth celebrating.

feeds.title: UK Aviation News
feeds.description: UK Aviation News is a leading independent resource for Aviation, Aerospace, Air Travel, Airline, and Airport news from across the United Kingdom. feeds.title: Fire Aviation
feeds.description: This blog shares firefighter news and commentary about aerial firefighting, air tankers, drones, smoke jumpers and helicopters. Again, we do not own or operate any aircraft or employ pilots, nor do we sell parts for aircraft.

feeds.title: AviTrader

feeds.title: Russian Aviation

feeds.title: Vintage Aviation News
